hook: Consistency beats brilliance. A B+ brand applied everywhere outperforms an A+ brand applied nowhere.
direction: Audit prompt: do your website, email, bulletin, and social look like the same organization? Faithfulness in small things — the principle transfers. Checklist graphic.

facebook.text:
Consistency beats brilliance. A B+ brand applied everywhere outperforms an A+ brand applied nowhere.

Quick audit: pull up your website, your last email, your bulletin, and your social profile side by side. Do they look like the same organization? Same colors, same fonts, same tone?

If someone has to guess whether they belong together, the answer is no.

Faithfulness in small things matters. That principle holds in ministry, in business, and in how you show up visually every single week. The checklist is simple. The discipline is the hard part.

instagram.text:
Consistency beats brilliance. A B+ brand applied everywhere outperforms an A+ brand applied nowhere.

Run this quick audit right now:

✓ Website
✓ Email newsletter
✓ Printed bulletin or handout
✓ Social media profile and posts

Do they look like the same organization? Same colors. Same fonts. Same voice.

If you have to think about it, they probably don't.

Faithfulness in small things. The principle transfers.
